In Europe, European tourists have long a: European tourists have long made regular use of the benefits of early booking. In the United Kingdom, for example, about 85% of tourists book their trips in advance, and the figures are similar in other European countries. This is because early booking discounts on tours and excursions can reach 40%. As a tourist, this service deserves your attention: it saves you money and time and secures quality early on!
Early Booking is a promotion jointly dev: Early booking is a promotion developed jointly by tour operators, hotels and airlines. It means that tour prices are reduced when booked in advance.
It is profitable for the hotel owner to: It pays for a hotel owner to sell some rooms before the season starts, even at a lower price, in order to guarantee occupancy during the season and to plan and cover the costs of preparing for it. The same is true of tour operators and airlines, for whom securing future sales is both beneficial and necessary.
1. Tourists can save up to 40% of their: 1. Tourists can save up to 40% when buying a tour through early booking promotions (and this does not affect its quality!). As a rule, discounts on early booking tours are 10-30%. For example, on a tour that costs $1000, that is a considerable sum ($100-300), and one well worth saving.
2. Early booking is also beneficial beca: 2. Early booking is also beneficial because you don’t have to worry about fluctuations in exchange rates (and prices usually rise during the season). Once you have paid for the tour, any changes in the foreign exchange market will not affect its cost. You will not need to pay anything extra if hotel prices, air fares or other expenses go up.
3. Availability of the best hotels and c: 3. Availability of the best hotels and convenient flights. A good hotel is a hotel in high demand. Remember that tourists come to quality hotels from all over the world, especially from countries where early booking is common, so the best hotels are all likely to sell out in advance.
4. No worries and no fuss associated wit: 4. No worry or fuss over preparing documents for a visa. This applies especially to countries that require a visa. Some certificates, permits and paperwork take a long time to process.
5. The fun of planning and anticipating: 5. The pleasure of planning and looking forward to a future holiday. When you know that your trip is booked and that new impressions and complete relaxation lie ahead, you work differently – more inspired and with greater ease.
